sources.title: Benchmarked some Strata Qwen3.8-flash-next quants

claims_and_limits.author_hardware: Radeon RX 7900 XT 20 GB + 64 GB RAM
claims_and_limits.harness: Pi coding-agent harness; author's daily-use setup
claims_and_limits.tasks: 89 total; mostly Aider Polyglot Python/JavaScript exercises plus 7 private repo-agent tasks; author says private tasks are not ready to release
claims_and_limits.post_disclaimer: Author says this is not a frontier benchmark
claims_and_limits.context: Author says context was kept consistent at maximum in a comment; exact per-profile configuration not supplied
claims_and_limits.run_duration: Author says one run takes about 5 hours; says more than 200 tasks would improve precision but is too costly for their setup
claims_and_limits.uncertainty: Bars are described by the author as Wilson 95% confidence intervals calculated from solved tasks / tasks; author says IQ3_XXS vs IQ3_S is within the margin/noise

comments: Most tasks are public Aider Polyglot Python/JavaScript; seven repo tasks are private and unreleased.
The author says the 89-task benchmark does not have enough tasks for precise ranking and each run takes about five hours.
The author says the Wilson intervals overlap for IQ3_XXS and IQ3_S and views their apparent ordering as noise/margin.

facts: the non-uniform GSQ-RCO files are separate from the Coder variant
Coder removes 256 of the 512 routed experts per layer
remaining weights are stored at 3.5 bpw
effective 1.89 bits per original parameter; the label IQ1_M is not the precision of each remaining weight
Release notes include --peer-device as an opt-in extra expert-cache tier
release notes claim the default output remains unchanged
Public repository is a curated collection of Exercism coding tasks; languages include C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python and Rust
Aider benchmark runs tasks in a harness and scores files against tests
documentation recommends Docker because generated code is executed
runner can randomize task order and filter to subsets

reason: One author run is about five hours, beyond the user's 30-minute total three-seed limit; seven tasks are private; exact prompts, profile fingerprints, seeds and raw per-task receipts were not supplied.
citation_policy: Community chart counts are transcribed from the public attached chart. They are not treated as locally verified quality scores or as evidence that one model is statistically superior.
